about:
American Plastic Manufacturing operates from Seattle, Washington, at 526 South Monroe Street. The company does business as American Plastic Mfg., Inc., though no founding year, ownership structure, or founder names are disclosed in the available information.

The firm produces custom printed plastic bags. Details about manufacturing processes, facility size, headcount, production volumes, or part-number range are not provided.

American Plastic sells exclusively through distributors; it does not sell directly to end users. Specific industries or customer types served are not listed, though the distributor model suggests the bags reach packaging, retail, food-service, and industrial supply channels.

No statement about competitive differentiation or founding mission appears in the source material.
